comment: Soft gzip target for the release main module. ADVISORY ONLY: exceeding it prints a warning (and a GitHub Actions annotation in CI) but never fails the build or the Cloudflare deploy. Re-ratcheted on 2026-11-18 to the measured 1008494 gz plus headroom. Almost all growth since the 640,000 target of 2026-06-15 (~617,742 measured then) came from upstream Hyperopen features merged before this fork branched (main was ~987 kB gz at upstream 1d103b49, e.g. Vol Range, portfolio and funding growth); this fork's own additions are ~13 kB. The diet goal in docs/exec-plans/active/2026-06-11-pagespeed-desktop-performance-90.md still stands and belongs upstream. Re-record with `node tools/release-assets/check_bundle_budget.mjs --update`, then add headroom.
